title: Adversarial Advocate-Skeptic-Arbiter screening deliberation
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; three-role adversarial screening deliberation and calibrated arbiter routing remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Isolated three-role screening protocol (`AdvocateAgent`, `SkepticAgent`, `CalibratedArbiter`) with strict context separation between Advocate and Skeptic
open_gates: Define DeliberationRole, CriterionArgument, ArbiterDisposition, and DeliberationTranscript contracts in crates/searchright-contracts/src/screening.rs.
Implement verbatim evidence quote byte-range validation, epistemic divergence calculation, and conservative CalibratedArbiter adjudication in crates/searchright-screening/src/lib.rs.
Enforce Advocate-Skeptic prompt isolation and non-autonomous final exclusion guards in crates/searchright-agent/src/lib.rs.
Add adversarial hallucinated-quote rejection, high-divergence human escalation, and non-human-consensus invariant tests.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
